title: Ongoing Management
meta: A first month of Amazon seller account care: listings, ads, orders, account health and a report. From $150, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Amazon ongoing management, started with a plan
overview: A steady routine keeps an Amazon account healthy. We review your account, agree a task list, and then complete the first round inside the sprint: listing checks, ad review, inventory and order checks, account health and a report. You get a weekly calendar and a written summary. A monthly plan is quoted separately if you want it, based on what your account actually needed.

pkgs.blurb: A care plan for your account and the first tasks done.
A first month of care with updates along the way.
A full month of care and a three-month plan for the account.

faq: Small repeat jobs like fixing a suppressed listing, answering a buyer message, adjusting a bid, checking a restock level or updating a price. Larger builds such as new A+ pages are quoted on their own.
No, it is a fixed starter sprint. At the end we say what your account needed and quote a monthly plan, if you want one, from tasks you have seen us do.
Will you run my ads in this sprint?
We review them and make bid and negative keyword changes in Standard and Premium. A full pay-per-click project is a separate service, which you can add if ads are your main focus.
How is my account kept safe?
We use only the access you give, work only by Amazon's rules, and never touch bank details. You can see every change, and you can remove access whenever you wish.
